question_record.context: A suspicious remote activity was observed on the machine with hostname `vnevado-win11u`. This alert indicated potential attempts to initiate interactive sessions, modify files, pass WMI commands, create scheduled tasks, or other potentially malicious activities from a remote machine. In connection with this incident, a ransomware payload was remotely launched on a device shortly after, likely attempting to encrypt content and render the device unusable.
question_record.question: What is the hostname of the device on which the ransomware payload was remotely launched?
solution: Suspicious activity initiated remotely was observed from IP `99.83.111.100`.
A ransomware payload was remotely launched on the device with HostName `vnevado-win11t`.
